forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Metaculus median for 'first general AI' remains Feb 2028; AI Frontiers gives 50% by 2028. No major capability jumps since last update. Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: Metaculus community: 25% by 2029; academic surveys median 25% by early 2030s

factors_up.factor: AI Frontiers estimates 50% by 2028, 80% by 2030
Multiple AI lab CEOs predicting AGI within 2-3 years
Rapid capability gains in reasoning and agentic tasks

factors_down.factor: Academic survey median remains early 2030s, not pre-2030
No consensus on AGI definition makes declaration unlikely
Historical pattern of overpromising on AI timelines

key_uncertainties: Definition disagreement means even if capabilities arrive, formal 'announcement' may lag
Scaling laws may hit diminishing returns before full generality

update_triggers.up: Major AI lab announces AGI-class system or passes comprehensive benchmarks
update_triggers.down: Scaling plateau, major safety incident causing regulatory pause

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: McKinsey revenue flat at $15-16B but AI consulting booming. Entry-level disruption real but overall industry adapting rather than contracting. Big 4 investing billions in AI. Slight decrease.
forecasts.base_rate: No historical precedent for 33% decline in professional services from technology in <6 years

factors_up.factor: McKinsey cutting ~10% non-client-facing staff
Entry-level roles being automated, 150 ex-consultants training AI models
AI tools commoditizing standard analysis and slide decks

factors_down.factor: AI consulting market growing rapidly ($11B in 2025, projected $90B by 2035)
Big 4 hiring more overall, McKinsey planning 12% staff increase in 2026
Consulting firms pivoting to AI advisory, creating new revenue streams
Only 4 years remain for 33% decline — extremely aggressive threshold

key_uncertainties: Whether AI tools enable clients to do consulting work in-house at scale
Speed of enterprise AI adoption for complex strategic decisions

update_triggers.up: Major consulting firm reports revenue decline >10% YoY attributed to AI
update_triggers.down: Continued revenue growth across Big 4 and MBB through 2026-2027

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Electoral Calculus now predicts Labour at just 63 seats (down from 79 in earlier polls). Reform at 266 seats. Labour polling at 17.8%, behind both Reform (26%) and Conservatives (18.4%). Green surge eating into Labour base. Slight decrease.
forecasts.base_rate: Governing parties rarely collapse this dramatically mid-term, but current polling is historically unprecedented

factors_up.factor: 3+ years until election deadline — time for recovery
Reform may struggle to maintain momentum through actual governing scrutiny

factors_down.factor: Labour polling at historic lows — 17.8%, predicted only 63 seats
Green Party taking one-third of combined left vote, fragmenting progressive base
Reform firmly in first place with 266 predicted seats
Combined Con+Lab vote share only 37.1%, structural realignment underway

key_uncertainties: Whether Labour can find a message that reverses the collapse before election
Whether Reform's support is durable or a protest vote that fades

update_triggers.up: Labour recovers to 25%+ in polls, Reform falls below 20%
update_triggers.down: Labour falls below 15%, leadership challenge materialises

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Metaculus median for 'general AI' is April 2033. Combined forecast puts AGI at 2030 (80% CI: 2027-2043). Expert consensus continues to pull timelines forward. Slight tick up.
forecasts.base_rate: Metaculus: 50% by 2033; combined forecaster estimate median 2030

factors_up.factor: Metaculus median now April 2033, well before 2035 deadline
Rapid investment ($100B+ annually across labs) accelerating progress
Multiple labs claiming near-AGI capabilities

factors_down.factor: Wide uncertainty interval (2027-2043) includes substantial post-2035 mass
Definition disputes mean formal recognition could lag capabilities
Possible regulatory or safety-driven slowdowns

key_uncertainties: Whether current scaling paradigm hits fundamental limits
Regulatory environment for frontier AI development

update_triggers.up: AI passes comprehensive AGI benchmarks, Metaculus median drops below 2030
update_triggers.down: Major scaling plateau, forecaster consensus shifts back toward 2040+

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: US intelligence reassessing — now says imminent attack unlikely. Polymarket: 3.1% by June 2026. PLA ADIZ incursions dropped sharply in early 2026 with 13-day pause. Blockade-by-coast-guard strategy emerging as preferred coercion tool. Slight decrease.
forecasts.base_rate: Historical base rate for major power initiating military action against defended territory: ~2-5% per year

factors_up.factor: Dec 2025 saw 100+ aircraft single-day episode, showing capability
Coast guard blockade strategy could blur into military action
Xi's personal commitment to unification goal

factors_down.factor: US intelligence assesses Beijing prefers non-military unification
PLA ADIZ incursions dropped sharply in early 2026
Amphibious assault recognised as extremely difficult with high failure risk
Economic costs of conflict would derail China's development

key_uncertainties: Whether grey-zone coast guard operations could escalate into military blockade meeting resolution criteria
Taiwan political developments that could provoke Beijing

update_triggers.up: Major military mobilisation, Taiwan independence declaration, US-China relations severe deterioration
update_triggers.down: Cross-strait dialogue resumption, sustained reduction in military pressure

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: CPI at 3.0% in February 2026. Bank of England projects 3-3.5% for Q2-Q3 2026. Only ~8 months remain. Would need dramatic deflationary shock to drop from 3%+ to below 2%. Holding at floor.
forecasts.base_rate: UK CPI has been above 2% since mid-2021; BoE forecasting 3%+ through Q3 2026

factors_up.factor: Energy price shock could reverse if global oil prices collapse

factors_down.factor: CPI at 3.0% — needs to drop 1+ percentage point in months
BoE explicitly forecasts 3-3.5% through Q3 2026
Services inflation remains sticky
Only 8 months remaining for resolution

key_uncertainties: Whether a global recession could cause rapid disinflation

update_triggers.up: Major global deflationary shock, oil price collapse below $40/barrel
update_triggers.down: BoE raises inflation forecast further (already essentially resolved DOWN)

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Trailer broke all-time record with 1 billion views. Industry projections range from $2.31B to $2.54B worldwide. Release date July 31, 2026 with 60-day theatrical window. No Way Home did $1.92B. Holding steady at high confidence.
forecasts.base_rate: Spider-Man: No Way Home grossed $1.92B; 3 of 8 Spider-Man films crossed $1B

factors_up.factor: Trailer set all-time record with 1B views — unprecedented pre-release engagement
Industry consensus projections $2.3-2.5B, well above $1.5B threshold
Tom Holland star power at peak, 60-day theatrical window

factors_down.factor: MCU fatigue could cap performance below projections
Absence of multiverse gimmick from No Way Home
Possible competition from other summer releases

key_uncertainties: Whether trailer hype translates to theatrical attendance at projected levels
Global economic conditions affecting discretionary entertainment spending

update_triggers.down: Negative critical reception, major competing release

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Major update: Anthropic hit $30B ARR (up from $9B just 4 months ago). OpenAI at $24-25B. Combined ~$54-55B in April 2026. Need $70B by Q4 2026. At current growth trajectories, highly likely. Increasing from 92%.
forecasts.base_rate: Combined ARR ~$54-55B as of April 2026; need ~$15-16B more in 8 months

factors_up.factor: Anthropic grew from $9B to $30B ARR in 4 months — extraordinary pace
Enterprise adoption accelerating — Anthropic doubled $1M+ clients in 2 months
Only need ~28-30% combined growth over remaining 8 months

factors_down.factor: Dispute over how Anthropic counts revenue — may be inflated
OpenAI growth slower — burning $17B/year with flat consumer base
Potential market saturation or enterprise spending pullback

key_uncertainties: Whether Anthropic's explosive growth rate is sustainable or a one-time enterprise migration spike
Revenue accounting methodology differences between the two companies

update_triggers.up: Q2 2026 reports showing continued 20%+ QoQ growth for either company
update_triggers.down: Revenue growth stalls, major enterprise churn, accounting restatement

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: OBR March 2026 forecasts average 1.6% over forecast period. IMF at 1.4-1.5%. Trend rate ~1.5%, right at the threshold. Question is essentially a coin flip on whether AI productivity gains push UK above trend. Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: OBR long-run trend growth ~1.5%; UK averaged ~1.4% in 2010s

factors_up.factor: AI productivity gains could boost growth above trend in 2030s
OBR forecasting 1.6% average over current forecast window
Post-Brexit adjustment costs dissipating by 2030s

factors_down.factor: IMF more pessimistic at 1.4-1.5% trend
Demographic headwinds from ageing population
Productivity puzzle has persisted since 2008 financial crisis
Fiscal consolidation may constrain public investment

key_uncertainties: Whether AI-driven productivity gains materialise at macroeconomic scale
Immigration policy and labour force growth trajectory

update_triggers.up: Productivity growth exceeds 1.5% sustained, major AI adoption in UK services sector
update_triggers.down: Recession in late 2020s, further productivity stagnation
